nodes.title: Fidelity dial
widgets_values:
THE FIDELITY DIAL (ref_boost) - how hard the model looks at your
reference. New in this release.

  1.0 = classic v1.1 behavior
  4.0 = recommended (pre-set): much stronger face + body likeness,
        more reliable edits
  >10 = over-copy: removals/replacements start failing
  <1  = suppress the reference (creative freedom)

ref_boost_a: the scene dial (image 1) in two-image mode -
leave at 1.0 unless you are exploring. ref_boost applies to the
person (image 2) when group 2 is enabled, else to your image.

fit_mode: how inputs fit a different output aspect
ratio. fit = resample to the output shape (default, recommended); crop (legacy) = center-crop
only for v1/v1.1 weights.

nodes.title: Enable for two-image edits
widgets_values:
OPTIONAL second reference - the PERSON for insert-into-scene edits
('place this person at the table').

This group ships DISABLED (purple = bypassed) - the workflow is a
plain single-image editor until you need it.
Enable: right-click this group's title bar -> toggle Bypass off.
Order rule: scene = image 1 (group 1), person = image 2 (here).

nodes.title: Sampling
widgets_values:
Turbo model: 10 steps, cfg 1.

Step dial:
  8  = stronger composition/instruction adherence
  12 = more face detail
  10 = balanced

Using krea2_raw instead of turbo:
40 steps, cfg 3-4 (negative then matters).
